title: OXR falsifying sign tuple
statement: For a Boolean map $\sigma:\{0,1,2\}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ and a sign $b\in\{\pm1\}$, define a sign tuple by starting with $(1,b,b)$ and negating coordinate $i$ exactly when $\sigma(i)$ is true.
